# GitHub Copilot — Repository Custom Instructions

These repository-wide instructions are mandatory.

Before working on any request, read:
- AGENTS.md
- AI_INSTRUCTIONS/README.md
- AI_INSTRUCTIONS/GLOBAL_INSTRUCTIONS.md

Also read AI_INSTRUCTIONS/RESEARCH_PROTOCOL.md for research and investigation tasks, and AI_INSTRUCTIONS/EXECUTION_PROTOCOL.md for coding, implementation, testing, debugging, Git, or delivery tasks. Read all applicable protocols for hybrid tasks.

Inspect the live repository and relevant project handoff documents before continuing existing work. Do not assume historical progress notes are current.

Work only on a dedicated branch or isolated working copy. Never commit directly to main. Do not merge, deploy, modify production, perform real-money trading, sign transactions, or transfer assets without explicit owner approval.

Report only actions and tests actually performed. If a required instruction file is unavailable, disclose the limitation instead of guessing.
